subject: Two-part onboarding workshop: API deep-dive + Console admin (scheduling)
messages:
From: Anna Morales <anna.morales@fintechco.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding sessions — request to schedule two workshops

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team found the Console tour really helpful. We have two groups at FintechCo that need more structured onboarding:

- Product & Integrations (console admin, org setup, ACLs) — ~8 people
- Platform & Backend (API keys, streaming, SDKs, token efficiency) — ~5 engineers

Would Redwood run two separate sessions next week (one focused on Console, one on API deep-dive)? Preferably 60–90 minutes each. Our proposed windows are:

- Tue 2 Jun, morning PST (9–11am)
- Wed 3 Jun, afternoon PST (1–4pm)

Attached is a short doc with our environment details and prerequisites.

Can you confirm availability and who from Redwood should lead each session? Also helpful to know any pre-reqs we should share with attendees.

Thanks,
Anna

----
Anna Morales
Head of Integrations | FintechCo
anna.morales@fintechco.com
Attachment: FintechCo_Onboarding_Prereqs.pdf (stated)
From: rachel.kim@redwood.com
To: Anna Morales <anna.morales@fintechco.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding sessions — request to schedule two workshops

Hi Anna — great to hear the demo landed well. Happy to run a two-part program. Quick answers up front:

- We can lead the Console admin session (me + Sean) and Dev Patel will take the API deep-dive.
- Recommended length: 75 minutes each (45–55 min content + 15–20 min Q/A and live troubleshooting).

Proposed slots (PST):
1) Tue 2 Jun, 9:30–10:45 — Console admin (recommended for Product & Integrations)
2) Wed 3 Jun, 13:30–14:45 — API deep-dive (recommended for Platform & Backend)

If those work, I’ll send calendar invites and a prep note for attendees (required: admin access for Console session; for API session we ask that one engineer have access to a small test project and API key).

I’ve attached a draft agenda to this message. Please confirm preferred slots and attendee list so we can lock rooms and calendars.

Thanks — Rachel

----
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147
Attachment: Workshop-Agenda-v1.docx (stated)
From: dev.patel@redwood.com
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: Anna Morales <anna.morales@fintechco.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding sessions — request to schedule two workshops

Heads up on a couple of technical notes that might change the suggested flow:

- For the API deep-dive, we should allocate 10–15 minutes to live request profiling (token counts, streaming vs non-streaming) — please ask the FintechCo engineer to bring a sample payload.
- If FintechCo wants to test streaming SDKs, we’ll need firewall allowlist entries for our demo IPs — I can provide those in a follow-up.

I agree with 75-minute sessions, but propose we make the API session 90 minutes if there’s appetite (extra time for hands-on pairing). If so, alternate slot: Wed 3 Jun, 13:30–15:00.

I’ll prepare a short troubleshooting checklist and a small Postman collection to share before the session.

— Dev

Rachel — thanks, both proposed slots work. We’ll take:

- Tue 2 Jun, 9:30–10:45 PST — Console admin (attendees: Anna Morales, Priya Shah, Mark Y.)
- Wed 3 Jun, 13:30–15:00 PST — API deep-dive (attendees: Carlos Ruiz, Jason T., Mei Lin)
